scenarios.title: A｜寄存行李
scenarios.setting: 在“退房后的安排”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“寄存行李”。

turns.prompt: 你想办理入住、出行或离店手续，会怎样说明来意？

choices.text: Could I leave my luggage here after I check out?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I leave my luggage here after I check out?
feedback.explanation: “check out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

choices.text: Do you offer luggage storage after check-out?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you offer luggage storage after check-out?
feedback.explanation: “check-out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

choices.text: Could you keep my bags for a few hours?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you keep my bags for a few hours?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Is there somewhere I can store my luggage until this afternoon?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there somewhere I can store my luggage until this afternoon?
feedback.explanation: “luggage”指行李的统称，通常不可数；数量可用“pieces of luggage”。

choices.text: Can I put my luggage here after check-out?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Could I leave my luggage here after I check out?
feedback.explanation: 这句能理解；“leave my luggage here”更自然地表达暂时寄存，而“put”更侧重放置动作。

turns.text: Of course. We can store your luggage for the day.

turns.prompt: 你想了解这项服务的费用，会怎么问？

choices.text: Is there a charge for that?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a charge for that?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: How long can you keep it for me?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long can you keep it for me?
feedback.explanation: “Can you …?”直接请对方帮忙，是常见口语请求；使用“can”本身并不等于不礼貌。

choices.text: Do I need to pick it up before a certain time?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to pick it up before a certain time?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Is the luggage storage area secure?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is the luggage storage area secure?
feedback.explanation: “luggage”指行李的统称，通常不可数；数量可用“pieces of luggage”。

turns.text: There’s no charge. Just collect it before midnight.

turns.prompt: 你想了解寄存行李后怎样取回，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. How do I get it back later?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. How do I get it back later?
feedback.explanation: “how do I get”询问到达方法，方便对方提供路线或交通方式。

choices.text: Will you give me a luggage tag or receipt?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will you give me a luggage tag or receipt?
feedback.explanation: “receipt”指收据或付款小票，是交易凭证。

choices.text: Do I need to show ID when I come back?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to show ID when I come back?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Perfect. I’ll pick it up around six.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’ll pick it up around six.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

turns.text: Here’s your luggage claim ticket. Bring this back when you collect your bags.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Got it. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Great, I’ll keep this with me. Thanks.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, I’ll keep this with me. Thanks.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: B｜让酒店叫车
scenarios.setting: 在“退房后的安排”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“让酒店叫车”。

turns.prompt: 你想请酒店协助安排离店交通，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you call a taxi for me, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you call a taxi for me, please?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Could you arrange a car to the airport?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you arrange a car to the airport?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I’d like a taxi to Central Station, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like a taxi to Central Station, please.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Could you get me a cab in about ten minutes?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you get me a cab in about ten minutes?
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

turns.text: Of course. Where are you heading?

turns.prompt: 你想补充地点或对象信息，方便对方确认，会怎么说？

choices.text: To the airport, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: To the airport, please.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: Central Station. I have a train at noon.

feedback.naturalExpression: Central Station. I have a train at noon.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Could you take this address and give it to the driver?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you take this address and give it to the driver?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

turns.text: Certainly. Would you like the taxi now?

turns.prompt: 你想说明日期、时长或时间上的需求，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, as soon as possible, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, as soon as possible, please.
feedback.explanation: “as soon as possible”表示尽快，说明事情紧急，但没有指定一个确定时点。

choices.text: In about fifteen minutes would be perfect.

feedback.naturalExpression: In about fifteen minutes would be perfect.
feedback.explanation: “would be perfect”把选择说成自己乐于接受的安排，比命令对方照办更柔和。

choices.text: Could you have it here at 10:30?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you have it here at 10:30?
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: I’d like a few minutes to get my luggage first.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like a few minutes to get my luggage first.
feedback.explanation: “luggage”指行李的统称，通常不可数；数量可用“pieces of luggage”。

turns.text: No problem. It’ll be outside the main entrance.

turns.prompt: 你想补充地点或对象信息，方便对方确认，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do you know roughly how long it will take to get to the airport?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know roughly how long it will take to get to the airport?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Can I pay the driver by card?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I pay the driver by card?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Great. I’ll wait outside. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll wait outside. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: C｜突然需要提前退房
scenarios.setting: 在“退房后的安排”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“突然需要提前退房”。

turns.prompt: 你想办理入住、出行或离店手续，会怎样说明来意？

choices.text: Hi, I need to check out earlier than planned.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I need to check out earlier than planned.
feedback.explanation: “check out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

choices.text: I’m afraid I have to leave a day early.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m afraid I have to leave a day early.
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

choices.text: I need to shorten my stay and check out today.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need to shorten my stay and check out today.
feedback.explanation: “check out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

choices.text: Something has come up, so I need to leave early.

feedback.naturalExpression: Something has come up, so I need to leave early.
feedback.explanation: “something has come up”在临时安排中表示出现了事情，常用于简短解释为什么要改约。

choices.text: I want to check out before my plan.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I need to check out earlier than planned.
feedback.explanation: 比原计划早用“earlier than planned”；“before my plan”不能表示原定退房时间之前。

turns.text: I’m sorry to hear that. You were originally scheduled to check out tomorrow, correct?

turns.prompt: 关于「退房后的安排」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Yes, but I need to leave today instead.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, but I need to leave today instead.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: That’s right. I won’t be staying tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s right. I won’t be staying tonight.
feedback.explanation: “that’s right”确认对方复述的信息无误，让对方可以继续办理或安排。

choices.text: Yes. Can you change my check-out date to today?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. Can you change my check-out date to today?
feedback.explanation: “check-out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

turns.text: Of course. Depending on your rate, there may be an early departure fee.

turns.prompt: 你想指出实际情况与订单或收费不一致的地方，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you tell me whether I’ll be charged for tonight?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you tell me whether I’ll be charged for tonight?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Is there an early check-out fee?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there an early check-out fee?
feedback.explanation: “check-out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

choices.text: Will I still have to pay for the remaining night?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I still have to pay for the remaining night?
feedback.explanation: “remaining night”指原预订中还未入住的那一晚，询问收费时能明确涉及的部分。

choices.text: Could you check the terms of my reservation?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check the terms of my reservation?
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

turns.text: Your rate allows changes, so you won’t be charged for tonight.

turns.prompt: 你想确认提前退房后的最终账单，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. Could you update the bill for me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Could you update the bill for me?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Thank you. Can I settle the final bill now?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. Can I settle the final bill now?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Perfect. I’d like to check out today, then.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’d like to check out today, then.
feedback.explanation: “check out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。
